note: AGED PRINT TEST (only with &age=1). 'lift' = the colour the blacks fade up towards. 'paper' = the warm tone the whites take on. Both are the full-age look; 'age' 0 to 1 scales them. 'grain' = grain strength at full age. 'amounts' = where the testing sliders start (tone, fade, grain, specks, scratches, dust, foxing; 0 = off, 1 = as set here, 2 = double). 'points' = how old the print is at a room; rooms between two points are in between. 'change' = seconds a change in age takes. 'marks' = how many of each blemish a print has (fewest, most; each print picks its own number in that range). The mark sliders only fade them.
